messages:
incidents-bot: [PAGER] control-plane: elevated 5xx error rate detected for controlplane-deps (svc-registry). Spike observed in us-west-2. Top affected routes: /config/*, /auth/*, /org/lookup. Threshold: 5xx > 3% over 3m.
maya: paging oncall — I can see dashboards showing a sharp spike. tagging folks.
oncall-bot: oncall rotation: jen_ops (primary), alex_sre (secondary). Paging jen_ops.
ops-jen: I have the page, looking now. Starting with metrics and logs.
alex_sre: joining. Adding context: svc-registry heartbeat calls to backends have elevated latency and connection resets.
ryan_eng: FYI we rolled svc-registry v2 yesterday ~00:10 UTC; v2 changed fanout semantics (sync fanout -> parallel). Could be related.
chris_cp: control-plane engineer here. Correlating traces: many callers are doing immediate fanout to billing/config/auth which amplifies failures.
maya: quick customer impact estimate?
elaine_pm: we're seeing multiple enterprise customers report token failures and invoice sync errors. Roughly 8-12% of API keys experiencing elevated errors in the last 10m.
ops-jen: grabbing logs from registry gateway ->
ops-jen: ```json
{"ts":"2026-03-15T12:34:56Z","service":"svc-registry","level":"error","msg":"heartbeat timeout","backend":"10.0.12.45:8080","err":"context deadline exceeded"}
```
alex_sre: backend responses include 502/504 from gateway to registry backends. TCP shows retransmits and resets.
ryan_eng: run a quick health check? ```curl -v https://svc-registry.us-west-2.internal/healthz```
chris_cp: digging stack traces — seeing repeated: ```java.lang.IllegalStateException: KV cache overflow at com.redwood.registry.Cache.put(Cache.java:214)``` — looks like cache regression under load.
maya: proposed mitigation plan (short):
1) Apply circuit-breaker on internal clients to svc-registry to stop cascading fanout.
2) Route /config and similar non-critical reads to cached-store fallback.
3) Rollback svc-registry v2 -> v1 (previous stable).
4) Scale svc-registry replicas and increase cache thresholds.
5) Throttle internal fanout (rate-limit jobs).
ops-jen: applying proxy CB rules now (envoy route config update). Will post diff.
ryan_eng: initiating rollback of svc-registry to v1 via canary -> full switch. Starting traffic migration now.
elaine_pm: prepping customer comms & status page draft. Support notified.
alex_sre: created incident tracker INC-2098; adding initial triage notes and runbook links.
oncall-bot: escalation: jen_ops assigned. ETA: 5m for first mitigation effects, 15m for rollback to finish.
ops-jen: proxy CB in place — some clients now receive 429s instead of timing out; initial metrics: 5xx rate down from 4.7% -> 1.9% in 3m window.
maya: good. Keep 5m rolling windows and post updates. Any long-running batch jobs impacted?
ryan_eng: paused billing fanout jobs to reduce additional load as part of mitigation.
chris_cp: rollback in progress — draining v2 pods, switching load to v1.
ops-jen: metrics: 5xx trending down to ~0.6%, p50/p95 latency returning to baseline.
elaine_pm: if trend stabilizes we'll publish a brief status with ETA for full resolution. Draft ready.
alex_sre: root-cause hypothesis: svc-registry v2 introduced a fanout pattern + cache sizing bug causing KV cache saturation -> backend OOM/timeouts -> propagated 5xx. Added to ticket.
maya: follow-up action items: increase cache memory limits, add backpressure/rate-limiting in client SDKs, enforce canary traffic caps for fanout changes, add saturation alert for KV cache size.
ops-jen: handing over monitoring to eng oncall (ryan_eng) for the next hour. I'll remain available for escalation.
ryan_eng: taking post-incident ownership. Will run RCA and schedule a remediation PR for cache fix and rollout guardrails.
incidents-bot: Incident INC-2098 severity lowered to P2. Pager closed. Please complete RCA and link to the incident ticket.
maya: thanks all — nice coordinated response :thumbsup:
